inscriptions.name: EDWARD REX
inscriptions.nameen: King Edward
inscriptions.description: エドワード王

inscriptions.name: UBI HAROLD DUX ANGLORUM ET SUI MILITES EQUITANT AD BOSHAM
inscriptions.nameen: Where Harold, Duke of the English, and his knights ride to Bosham
inscriptions.description: イングランド公ハロルドとその騎士たちがボシャムへ馬で向かうところ

inscriptions.name: ECCLESIA
inscriptions.nameen: Church
inscriptions.description: 教会

inscriptions.name: HIC HAROLD MARE NAVIGAVIT
inscriptions.nameen: Here Harold sailed the sea
inscriptions.description: ここでハロルドは海を航行した

inscriptions.name: ET VELIS VENTO PLENIS VENIT IN TERRAM WIDONIS COMITIS
inscriptions.nameen: And with sails full of wind he came into the land of Count Guy
inscriptions.description: そして帆に風をいっぱいに受けてギー伯の領地へ到達した

inscriptions.name: HAROLD
inscriptions.nameen: Harold
inscriptions.description: ハロルド

inscriptions.name: HIC APPREHENDIT WIDO HAROLDUM
inscriptions.nameen: Here Guy seized Harold
inscriptions.description: ここでギーはハロルドを捕らえた

inscriptions.name: ET DUXIT EUM AD BELREM ET IBI EUM TENUIT
inscriptions.nameen: And led him to Beaurain and held him there
inscriptions.description: そして彼をボーランへ連行し、そこに監禁した

inscriptions.name: UBI HAROLD ET WIDO PARABOLANT
inscriptions.nameen: Where Harold and Guy parley
inscriptions.description: ハロルドとギーが話し合うところ

inscriptions.name: UBI NUNTII WILLELMI DUCIS VENERUNT AD WIDONEM
inscriptions.nameen: Where Duke William's messengers came to Guy
inscriptions.description: ウィリアム公の使者たちがギーのもとへ来たところ

inscriptions.name: TUROLD
inscriptions.nameen: Turold
inscriptions.description: テュロルド

inscriptions.name: NUNTII WILLELMI
inscriptions.nameen: William's messengers
inscriptions.description: ウィリアムの使者たち

inscriptions.name: HIC VENIT NUNTIUS AD WILGELMUM DUCEM
inscriptions.nameen: Here the messenger came to Duke William
inscriptions.description: ここで使者がウィリアム公のもとへ来た

inscriptions.name: HIC WIDO ADDUXIT HAROLDUM AD WILGELMUM NORMANNORUM DUCEM
inscriptions.nameen: Here Guy brought Harold to William, Duke of the Normans
inscriptions.description: ここでギーはハロルドをノルマン人の公ウィリアムのもとへ連れてきた

inscriptions.name: HIC DUX WILGELM CUM HAROLDO VENIT AD PALATIUM SUUM
inscriptions.nameen: Here Duke William came with Harold to his palace
inscriptions.description: ここでウィリアム公はハロルドとともに自らの宮殿へ来た

inscriptions.name: UBI UNUS CLERICUS ET AELFGYVA
inscriptions.nameen: Where a certain cleric and Ælfgyva...
inscriptions.description: ある聖職者とエルフギヴァがいるところ

inscriptions.name: HIC WILLELM DUX ET EXERCITUS EIUS VENERUNT AD MONTEM MICHAELIS
inscriptions.nameen: Here Duke William and his army came to Mont-Saint-Michel
inscriptions.description: ここでウィリアム公とその軍勢はモン・サン・ミシェルへ来た

inscriptions.name: ET HIC TRANSIERUNT FLUMEN COSNONIS HIC HAROLD DUX TRAHEBAT EOS DE ARENA
inscriptions.nameen: And here they crossed the River Couesnon; here Duke Harold dragged them from the sand
inscriptions.description: そしてここで彼らはクエノン川を渡った。ここでハロルド公が彼らを砂（流砂）から引き上げた

inscriptions.name: ET VENERUNT AD DOL ET CONAN FUGA VERTIT
inscriptions.nameen: And they came to Dol and Conan turned in flight
inscriptions.description: そして彼らはドルへ来ると、コナンは敗走した

inscriptions.name: REDNES
inscriptions.nameen: Rennes
inscriptions.description: レンヌ

inscriptions.name: HIC MILITES WILLELMI DUCIS PUGNANT CONTRA DINANTES ET CUNAN CLAVES PORREXIT
inscriptions.nameen: Here Duke William's knights fight against the men of Dinan, and Conan handed over the keys
inscriptions.description: ここでウィリアム公の騎士たちはディナンの人々と戦い、コナンは鍵を差し出した

inscriptions.name: HIC WILLELM DEDIT HAROLDO ARMA
inscriptions.nameen: Here William gave arms to Harold
inscriptions.description: ここでウィリアムはハロルドに武具を与えた

inscriptions.name: HIC WILLELM VENIT BAGIAS UBI HAROLD SACRAMENTUM FECIT WILLELMO DUCI
inscriptions.nameen: Here William came to Bayeux, where Harold swore an oath to Duke William
inscriptions.description: ここでウィリアムはバイユーへ来た。そこでハロルドはウィリアム公に誓いを立てた

inscriptions.name: HIC HAROLD DUX REVERSUS EST AD ANGLICAM TERRAM
inscriptions.nameen: Here Duke Harold returned to English soil
inscriptions.description: ここでハロルド公はイングランドの地へ帰還した

inscriptions.name: ET VENIT AD EDWARDUM REGEM
inscriptions.nameen: And came to King Edward
inscriptions.description: そしてエドワード王のもとへ来た

inscriptions.name: HIC PORTATUR CORPUS EADWARDI REGIS AD ECCLESIAM SANCTI PETRI APOSTOLI
inscriptions.nameen: Here the body of King Edward is carried to the Church of St. Peter the Apostle
inscriptions.description: ここでエドワード王の遺体が使徒聖ペテロ教会へ運ばれる

inscriptions.name: HIC EADWARDUS REX IN LECTO ALLOQUITUR FIDELES
inscriptions.nameen: Here King Edward in bed speaks to his faithful followers
inscriptions.description: ここでエドワード王は病床で忠臣たちに語りかける

inscriptions.name: ET HIC DEFUNCTUS EST
inscriptions.nameen: And here he died
inscriptions.description: そしてここで彼は崩御した

inscriptions.name: HIC DEDERUNT HAROLDO CORONAM REGIS
inscriptions.nameen: Here they gave the king's crown to Harold
inscriptions.description: ここで人々はハロルドに王冠を授けた

inscriptions.name: HIC RESIDET HAROLD REX ANGLORUM STIGANT ARCHIEPISCOPUS
inscriptions.nameen: Here sits Harold, King of the English; Archbishop Stigand
inscriptions.description: ここにイングランド王ハロルドが座す。大司教スティガンド

inscriptions.name: ISTI MIRANT STELLA
inscriptions.nameen: These men marvel at the star
inscriptions.description: この人々は星を見て驚いている

inscriptions.name: HAROLD
inscriptions.nameen: Harold
inscriptions.description: ハロルド

inscriptions.name: HIC NAVIS ANGLICA VENIT IN TERRAM WILLELMI DUCIS
inscriptions.nameen: Here an English ship came into the land of Duke William
inscriptions.description: ここでイングランドの船がウィリアム公の領地へ来た

inscriptions.name: HIC WILLELM DUX IUSSIT NAVES AEDIFICARE
inscriptions.nameen: Here Duke William ordered ships to be built
inscriptions.description: ここでウィリアム公は船の建造を命じた

inscriptions.name: HIC TRAHUNT NAVES AD MARE
inscriptions.nameen: Here they drag the ships to the sea
inscriptions.description: ここで人々は船を海へ曳き出す

inscriptions.name: ISTI PORTANT ARMAS AD NAVES ET HIC TRAHUNT CARRUM CUM VINO ET ARMIS
inscriptions.nameen: These men carry arms to the ships, and here they pull a cart with wine and arms
inscriptions.description: この人々は武具を船へ運び、ここで葡萄酒と武具を積んだ荷車を引く

inscriptions.name: HIC WILLELM DUX IN MAGNO NAVIGIO MARE TRANSIVIT ET VENIT AD PEVENESAE
inscriptions.nameen: Here Duke William crossed the sea in a great fleet and came to Pevensey
inscriptions.description: ここでウィリアム公は大船団で海を渡り、ペヴェンジーへ到達した

inscriptions.name: HIC EXEUNT CABALLI DE NAVIBUS
inscriptions.nameen: Here the horses leave the ships
inscriptions.description: ここで馬たちが船から降りる

inscriptions.name: ET HIC MILITES FESTINAVERUNT HESTINGA UT CIBUM RAPERENTUR
inscriptions.nameen: And here the knights hurried to Hastings to seize food
inscriptions.description: そしてここで騎士たちは食糧を徴発するためヘイスティングズへ急いだ

inscriptions.name: HIC EST WADARD
inscriptions.nameen: Here is Wadard
inscriptions.description: ここにワダードがいる

inscriptions.name: HIC COQUITUR CARO ET HIC MINISTRAVERUNT MINISTRI
inscriptions.nameen: Here the meat is cooked and here the servants served
inscriptions.description: ここで肉が調理され、ここで給仕たちが配膳した

inscriptions.name: HIC FECERUNT PRANDIUM
inscriptions.nameen: Here they took their meal
inscriptions.description: ここで彼らは食事をとった

inscriptions.name: HIC EPISCOPUS CIBUM ET POTUM BENEDICIT ODO EPISCOPUS WILLELM ROTBERT
inscriptions.nameen: Here the bishop blesses the food and drink: Bishop Odo, William, Robert
inscriptions.description: ここで司教が食べ物と飲み物を祝福する。オド司教、ウィリアム、ロベール

inscriptions.name: ISTE IUSSIT UT FODERETUR CASTELLUM AT HESTENGA CEASTRA
inscriptions.nameen: He ordered that a castle be dug at the camp of Hastings
inscriptions.description: この人がヘイスティングズの陣営に城砦（土塁）を掘るよう命じた

inscriptions.name: HIC NUNTIATUM EST WILLELMO DE HAROLDO
inscriptions.nameen: Here news was brought to William about Harold
inscriptions.description: ここでウィリアムにハロルドについての報告がなされた

inscriptions.name: HIC DOMUS INCENDITUR
inscriptions.nameen: Here a house is burned
inscriptions.description: ここで家が焼き払われる

inscriptions.name: HIC MILITES EXIERUNT DE HESTENGA ET VENERUNT AD PRELIUM CONTRA HAROLDUM REGEM
inscriptions.nameen: Here the knights left Hastings and came to battle against King Harold
inscriptions.description: ここで騎士たちはヘイスティングズを出撃し、ハロルド王との戦いへ向かった

inscriptions.name: HIC WILLELM DUX INTERROGAT VITAL SI VIDISSET EXERCITUM HAROLDI
inscriptions.nameen: Here Duke William asks Vital if he has seen Harold's army
inscriptions.description: ここでウィリアム公はヴィタルにハロルドの軍勢を見たかと尋ねる

inscriptions.name: ISTE NUNTIAT HAROLDUM REGEM DE EXERCITU WILELMI DUCIS
inscriptions.nameen: This man informs King Harold about Duke William's army
inscriptions.description: この人がハロルド王にウィリアム公の軍勢について報告する

inscriptions.name: HIC WILLELM DUX ALLOQUITUR SUIS MILITIBUS UT PREPARARENT SE VIRILITER ET SAPIENTER AD PRELIUM CONTRA ANGLORUM EXERCITUM
inscriptions.nameen: Here Duke William exhorts his soldiers to prepare themselves manfully and wisely for battle against the English army
inscriptions.description: ここでウィリアム公は自らの騎士たちに、イングランド軍との戦いに向けて勇敢かつ賢明に備えるよう語りかける

inscriptions.name: HIC CECIDERUNT LEWINE ET GYRD FRATRES HAROLDI REGIS
inscriptions.nameen: Here fell Leofwine and Gyrth, brothers of King Harold
inscriptions.description: ここでハロルド王の兄弟レオフウィンとギルスが倒れた

inscriptions.name: HIC CECIDERUNT SIMUL ANGLI ET FRANCI IN PRELIO
inscriptions.nameen: Here English and French fell together in battle
inscriptions.description: ここでイングランド人とフランス人が戦いでともに倒れた

inscriptions.name: HIC ODO EPISCOPUS BACULUM TENENS CONFORTAT PUEROS
inscriptions.nameen: Here Bishop Odo, holding a club, encourages the young warriors
inscriptions.description: ここでオド司教は棍棒を手にして若者たちを励ます

inscriptions.name: HIC EST WILLELM DUX
inscriptions.nameen: Here is Duke William
inscriptions.description: ここにウィリアム公がいる

inscriptions.name: ISTE FRANCI PUGNANT ET CECIDERUNT QUI ERANT CUM HAROLDO
inscriptions.nameen: These Frenchmen fight, and those who were with Harold fell
inscriptions.description: このフランス人たちは戦い、ハロルドとともにいた者たちが倒れた

inscriptions.name: HIC HAROLD REX INTERFECTUS EST
inscriptions.nameen: Here King Harold was killed
inscriptions.description: ここでハロルド王は殺害された

inscriptions.name: ET FUGA VERTERUNT ANGLI
inscriptions.nameen: And the English turned in flight
inscriptions.description: そしてイングランド人たちは敗走した

inscriptions.name: ET FUGA VERTERUNT ANGLI
inscriptions.nameen: And the English turned in flight (Finale)
inscriptions.description: そしてイングランド人たちは敗走した（終幕）
